nodes.description: Owner address stored in BotProtected/GenShards; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as sole access-control gate for delegate and list.
External Ferrum launch-protection contract address; target of the low-level call performed by the checkBots modifier.
Uniswap V2 pair address computed at construction time via pairFor and used by the bot-protection call.
Public token balance mapping of GenShards; mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and list.
Public allowance mapping of GenShards; decremented without SafeMath inside transferFrom.
Total token supply, initialized to a hard-coded value and rewritable through list.
Uniswap V2 router address used for the liquidity call in list.
Wrapped ETH address used to derive the Uniswap pair.
Token decimals constant (18).
Token name string 'Gen Shards'.
Token symbol string 'GS'.
Modifier that makes an external low-level call to botProtection before the modified function body executes.
GenShards constructor: sets owner, computes uniPair and grants unlimited allowances to router and pair.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
Core transfer routine with checkBots modifier and unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic (Solidity 0.7.0).
Public payable approval setter that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address and calldata.
Internal pure function computing the Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 hashing.
Owner-only distribution/liquidity function writing arbitrary balances to arbitrary addresses and calling addLiquidityETH.
BotProtected constructor receiving and storing the bot-protection contract address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowances and transfer authorization.
Miner-influenced time value used to build the Uniswap deadline in list.
External low-level call to botProtection executed before state changes in transferFrom; potential reentrancy and untrusted-callee vector.
User-supplied delegatecall executing arbitrary code with this contract's storage.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value (no SafeMath, Solidity 0.7.0).
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value (no SafeMath).
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
External Uniswap router addLiquidityETH call forwarding msg.value and owner-controlled parameters.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the GenShards constructor.
Constructor consumes msg.sender to set owner and unlimited allowances.
_botProtection constructor argument is stored into botProtection.
_botProtection is forwarded to the BotProtected base constructor.
Constructor calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair.
pairFor return value is assigned to uniPair.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes _from when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
_from modifier parameter flows into the checkBots call data.
_to modifier parameter flows into the checkBots call data.
_value modifier parameter flows into the checkBots call data.
checkBots executes the low-level external call.
botProtection is the callee target of the low-level call.
The external call in the modifier runs before transferFrom mutates balances, allowing reentrant state changes.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balance subtraction.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balance addition.
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance subtraction.
balanceOf mapping supplies the value decremented by the subtraction.
Unchecked subtraction writes back into balanceOf.
balanceOf mapping supplies the value incremented by the addition.
Unchecked addition writes back into balanceOf.
allowance mapping supplies the value decremented.
Unchecked subtraction writes back into allowance.

_to parameter indexes the credited balance.
_value parameter is subtracted from the allowance.

require(msg.sender == owner) gates the list function.
block.timestamp builds the router deadline, making the call timestamp dependent.
